reason: Recounted on the 65SC12. All opcodes are NMOS 6502 ones, so they are valid. Up path: old (from the BCC through LDA ra_lo) 68 cycles in ring, 69 on a wrap; new 56: -12 in ring, -13 on a wrap. Not-up path: BCC not taken 2 becomes BCS taken 3, +1. The BCS goes forward from &9D55 to about &9D7C, inside page &9D: in range and no page cross. Bytes: old 56, new 47: -9. raise_cells_lo/hi move to &9D82-&9D91, still in one page, so ,Y reads 0-7 never cross. ORA #&40 equals the old CMP #&40/BCS/ADC #&40 for any hi in &00-&7F. Without an underflow the result is below &80, so OR and add agree. With an underflow (hi < table + borrow, table at most &14) the result is &EB or more, so bit 6 is already set and both leave it alone. They differ only for hi of &80 or more, which the game's screen-address helpers never produce (movers_screen_address_high comes only from add/subtract_delta and the row helpers, or the initial &00). C and V on exit change in the wrap case (old C=0 V=0, new C=1 V=whatever SBC left), but the one caller (ren_draw_sprite, &9B5A) reads neither before overwriting them (STA/AND/TRB/STX/LDA/BNE, then BIT dm_flip, or compiled_part's ASL/ROL, or CMP). The self-modified operands lo_imm and rows_imm are still written by STA lo_imm/STY rows_imm by label, and lo_imm is still the LDA #imm operand with the same meaning. ra_hi is no longer written and nothing else reads it. The 9-byte slide from restore_block (&9D9B) to the end of bank 4's code (&B37D), checked in the listing: BPL each_part (&9DFF) stops crossing (-1 a time taken, about 2 a pass). record_differs' first two BNE out (&9FFE, &A006) start crossing: +1 a time taken, about 1.3 a pass by the window's measured counts. Sky's BEQ right (&A204) starts crossing (under 0.5 a pass). The indexed reads into the region only lose crossings (base low bytes fall by 9, none wraps from &00). No branch from before the region targets inside it. Net per pass: about +29.8 from the routine and roughly 0 from the slide, which agrees with the measured render -23 (seed 1). Per execution of the up path: 12 cycles, 12.2 counting the wraps.
